The woman's hair is shiny, smooth, and healthy-looking. She touches it and smiles, looking satisfied with the results. The lighting is bright and flattering, highlighting the shine of the hair strands. (14) The video ends with a composite shot. The woman is in a small circle at the bottom left, gesturing with her hands. Above her, the three Pantene products are displayed against a white background with pink heart graphics and sparkles.
